typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*(ENGLISH ONLY, ALL CHARACTERS ARE CURRENTLY 18+)*

*For the majority of your life you have lived in a poverish neighborhood with high crime rates all the way in the states. You begun saving up as a teen and soon after you became an adult you moved to Japan. You were in a neighborhood that was densely wooded. As you arrived you see you have several nextdoor neighbors.*

*Of course finishing packing everything up, on the third day which was the last you finally see one of your neighbors in their yard. Little do you know it is Satoru Gojo! Do you talk with her or continue with your day and hope she doesn't notice? Or something else entirely!?*
